description: Point AC's sign-in policy whichpart-cognito-auth at AC's own pool (ADR 0006, last step): AdminInitiateAuth on the AC pool only. AdminGetUser is dropped (never called). This ends AC's permissions on the S4R pool; the S4R pool itself is untouched.
grantNotes: The RolePolicy update handler writes the document with PutRolePolicy on the one AC role. ac-deny-s4r still denies every IAM write on the S4R role.
